column7: STORAGE-ERR-CLASS-5 item 4: the alert-escalation, notification-channel and rotation-policy handlers answered 404 for any error whose text contained "not found" (strings.Contains), so a storage read fault with those words in the driver message read as a missing policy/channel, and a closed DB answered 404/500. Each Get/Update/Delete (and the channel retry-policy get/set) now classifies by the typed storage not-found (ErrAlertEscalationNotFound, ErrNotificationChannelNotFound, ErrRotationPolicyNotFound: 404) and answers a storage read fault 503 storage_unavailable. Validation refusals are typed core.ErrInvalidInput, so the validation text matchers are gone too. 15 rows deleted from internal/core/guards/testdata/errtext_classification_exceptions.tsv. Red on main.
